commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Full-text search of npm packages hosted on jsDelivr (Algolia index), with optional facet filters such as module type, style type or author

commands.name: get-npm-package-info
commands.summary: Get full npm metadata for a package from the search index: description, latest version, version release dates, npm downloads, jsDelivr hits, repo and owner

commands.name: list-package-versions
commands.summary: List all versions and dist-tags of an npm package or GitHub repo hosted on jsDelivr

commands.name: list-package-files
commands.summary: Get the file tree (names, sizes, SHA-256 hashes) and default file of a specific package version

commands.name: get-package-entrypoints
commands.summary: Get the resolved JS/CSS entrypoint files of an npm package version (the file served by the short CDN URL)

commands.name: get-package-readme
commands.summary: Get the rendered README (HTML) of an npm package or GitHub repo

commands.name: get-package-stats
commands.summary: Get CDN hits and bandwidth for a package over a period, with daily breakdown, rank and previous-period comparison

commands.name: get-package-version-stats
commands.summary: List a package's versions ranked by CDN hits or bandwidth over a period

commands.name: get-package-file-stats
commands.summary: List the files of a specific package version ranked by CDN hits or bandwidth over a period

commands.name: list-top-packages
commands.summary: List the most-used packages on jsDelivr, ranked by hits or bandwidth, optionally restricted to npm or GitHub

commands.name: get-network-stats
commands.summary: Get total jsDelivr network hits and bandwidth per CDN provider (Cloudflare, Fastly) over a period, optionally for one country

commands.name: get-network-content-stats
commands.summary: Get network hits and bandwidth split by content type (packages vs. proxies) with a daily breakdown

commands.name: list-network-countries
commands.summary: Get jsDelivr network hits broken down by country (country code, name, total hits, previous-period hits)

commands.name: list-top-browsers
commands.summary: List browsers by share of jsDelivr traffic, optionally for one country

commands.name: list-top-platforms
commands.summary: List operating systems/platforms by share of jsDelivr traffic, optionally for one country

commands.name: get-proxy-stats
commands.summary: Get CDN hits and bandwidth for one of jsDelivr's proxy endpoints (e.g. pyodide, fontsource, ghost) over a period

commands.name: list-stats-periods
commands.summary: List the fixed statistics periods available (calendar months/quarters/years such as 2026-09 or 2026-Q3) with links to their stats
